colour_space: 8-bit straight-alpha sRGB; no ICC profiles in synthetic inputs

distance.name: Euclidean OKLab
distance.scale: L in [0,1]; a and b unscaled; not deltaE*100
distance.comparison: Unordered role-aware anchor matching. Compare source RGB, not white/black-composited RGB. Alpha is coverage, not a colour. Ignore RGB at alpha=0. Background colour may also be an enclosed foreground anchor.
distance.ranking: No anchor ranking or engine cluster count is asserted.

png-opaque.basis: Lossless integer RGB samples; floating-point conversion allowance only.

png-alpha.basis: Lossless encoded straight RGBA; allowance for <=2 channel units from 8-bit premultiply/unpremultiply at alpha>=64. Encoded sample truth remains exact.

jpeg-q95.basis: Lossy JPEG quality 95, chroma subsampling and DCT rounding. Anchor checks use flat interiors >=8 pixels from edges, never boundary ringing. Conservative preregistered budget, not a universal JPEG bound.

webp-q95.basis: Lossy WebP quality 95, YUV/chroma quantization. Flat interior checks only, >=8 pixels from edges. Conservative preregistered budget, not a universal WebP bound.

webp-alpha-q95.basis: WebP lossy RGB plus alpha roundtrip; same interior-only rule, source alpha>=64.

svg-flat.basis: Literal sRGB fills in axis-aligned integer rectangles; no fonts, gradients, antialias boundary or filters in colour-truth probes.

limits_for_negative_cases.animation_policy: reject, never choose an arbitrary frame
limits_for_negative_cases.svg_policy: Reject external/network/file/data references, DTD/entities, scripts, foreignObject and animation; local fragment-only use is a positive control. Never dereference hostile fixtures.

truth_contract.known-colour: Manually authored geometry, exact source RGBA and areas. Expected foreground/background anchors are human labels, not extraction output. RGB exactness applies to PNG/SVG source samples; codec error budgets apply to lossy anchor comparisons.
truth_contract.source-colour-only: Existing SVG literal fills are known; font rasterization, glyph coverage and extracted dominance are not. Do not score these as pixel/anchor truth.
truth_contract.determinism-only: Exact bytes and dimensions frozen, no expected colour accuracy or anchor count. Compare repeated future engine outputs, not an invented colour target.
truth_contract.negative: Static header/reference facts only; no engine was run. Expected rejection is a future security contract, not a claim about current implementation.

freeze_rule: Use only the listed cases and embedded bytes. Do not regenerate, fetch source assets, add random cases or tune thresholds after observing an engine. A changed corpus requires a separately versioned benchmark.
alpha_notes: Alpha-zero nonzero RGB must be checked in the inflated PNG bytes, not canvas readback, which discards hidden RGB. Partial-alpha probes compare straight RGB and exact alpha separately; no implicit compositing.
source_asset_root: A worktree at fixture preparation; source paths are provenance only, never runtime dependencies.
